Trace, implement and test: leetcode136 single number bit operation

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<cstdio>
#include<vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int singleNumber(vector<int>& nums) {
        if (nums.empty()) return 0;
        const int len = nums.size();
        int res = nums.front();
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++)
            res = res ^ nums[i];  /* 基于异或^运算来做成对抵消 */
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {4, 1, 2, 1, 2};
    printf("%d ", sol.singleNumber(nums));
    return 0;
}
